subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the slab-on-deck pour strip between Structural

messages.text: The slab-on-deck pour strip reinforcement shown in Structural Detail 3/S502 conflicts with additional #5 ties noted in Structural General Notes S-001. This is urgent -- we need direction as soon as possible. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is directly on the critical path for the current pour sequence. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible. Honestly, this could go either way on how fast it needs a response -- reasonable people on the team see it differently.

Proceed with additional #5 ties per Structural General Notes S-001; Structural Detail 3/S502 is superseded. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is directly on the critical path for the current pour sequence.
